checklist.reviewer_action: Restore the artifact, regenerate the handoff bundle, or record owner acceptance before release.
checklist.title: No evidence handoff artifacts were removed.

checklist.reviewer_action: Regenerate missing artifacts before release or explicitly remove them from the release evidence set.
checklist.title: No previously present evidence artifact became missing.

checklist.reviewer_action: Do not release until removed boundary language is restored or the release owner accepts the changed boundary.
checklist.title: No existing local-only, no-live-data, no-private-data, or non-advice boundary was removed.

checklist.reviewer_action: Review safety notice text against the non-advice boundary before release.
checklist.title: The safety notice did not change between evidence handoff audits.

checklist.reviewer_action: Inspect added artifacts for source scope, stale/static labeling, and release-owner relevance.
checklist.title: Added evidence artifacts are reviewed for public-source, local-only, and non-advice boundaries.

checklist.reviewer_action: Review the changed artifact diff or regeneration command before release.
checklist.title: Changed byte counts or SHA-256 hashes are explained by intentional generated artifact or documentation updates.

checklist.reviewer_action: Confirm role changes still route artifacts to the right reviewer handoff bucket.
checklist.title: Evidence role changes are intentional and do not hide release evidence.

checklist.reviewer_action: Review source-boundary and freshness notes; do not treat stale/static artifacts as current analysis.
checklist.title: Freshness and source-boundary metadata changes are reviewed before release.

checklist.reviewer_action: Confirm added boundary text is consistent with public docs and generated evidence.
checklist.title: New boundary language is reviewed for consistency across public docs and generated artifacts.

release_owner_notes: This checklist summarizes metadata from evidence handoff compare artifacts; it does not embed artifact contents.
A clear checklist does not approve tagging, publishing, hosted demo deployment, or public announcement.
The release owner must review changed evidence, stale/static labels, and source boundaries before relying on the handoff.
safety_notice: Educational research review only. This tool does not provide personalized investment, legal, accounting, tax, buy, sell, or hold advice. Verify source materials and note that stale/static data may no longer reflect current conditions.
